512-4644-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4644-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4644-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4976-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4976-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1659-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2292-7940--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm

2084-7936.description: Activate Dominion Saboteur by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Dominion Saboteur into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

997-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
997-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

5220-5931-6505-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
5220-5931-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-3967-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 11.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7379.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2653-2692-2893-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

671-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2374-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2374-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

325-1786-5435-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1786-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

440-1339-2498-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2498-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Sheoldred trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

220-2164-6102.description:
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Ashling triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw a card.
Resolve Chain of Plasma, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter and choosing to discard a card to copy it.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 (getting Ashling's additional results once each).

413-708-736-2459.notablePrerequisites: Copy Enchantment is a copy of Myth Unbound.
413-708-736-2459.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3750-4871-5549.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Treasures.
3750-4871-5549.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing all Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassins in addition to their other types.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
When the Treasures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers five times, creating five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Aggravated Assault ability, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-2043.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of any artifact you control that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

186-509-4131.notablePrerequisites: Idris does not have summoning sickness.
186-509-4131.description:
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

259-2104-2334.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
Halo-Charged Skaab and Soulherder's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Halo-Charged Skaab trigger, causing each player to mill two cards and put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

4-2963-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows either from your hand or from exile by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.

15-719-1339-2034.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Xenograft.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-719-1339-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1964-1987-2427-2493.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
